from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689869/attempts/bb90a5c04b7e45689f74d9e2a14a4f73/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    """Fill the one-cell horizontal gaps between matching markers with color 2."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, len(row) - 1):
            if row[c] != 2 and row[c - 1] == row[c + 1] and row[c - 1] not in (2, 6):
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
